answer: Use the Market Directory to find markets by area, opening day, or produce type.
Each market detail page shows its opening days and hours. You can also browse the market directory to find a market.
The Produce Guide shows when each product is available and which markets sell it.
Choose a month on the Seasonal Produce page to see available products and related markets.
Save your favorite markets and products, then view them and add notes on the Bookmarks page.
You can find our contact information on the Contact page.
